reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked guard used by all providers, but copies the unlink field-clearing instead of extracting it from unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: The db.updateAccount block nulling account_id, bank, balances, sync source and status is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount.

placement.why: A mutating unlink is hidden inside a function named and used as a validation guard, so the side effect lives in the check layer rather than a link/unlink step.

scope.why: Only the link parameter, the guard and the provider link functions plus a test are touched.

maintainability.why: Single decision point for all providers is good, but a guard that silently mutates and a duplicated 'unlinked state' definition will drift from unlinkAccount.

bypasses_abstraction.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked writes the unlinked state directly instead of sharing the field reset used by unlinkAccount

disguised_duplication.where: the unlink field reset is copied verbatim, not disguised
